newsitem.title: USA: Woodbury Telephone board OKs SNET merger.
newsitem.headline: Woodbury Telephone board OKs SNET merger.

text.p: Woodbury Telephone said Wednesday its board of directors approved a deal for Southern New England Telecommunications to buy the 63.5 percent of outstanding Woodbury shares it did not already own.
Under the previously announced agreement, Southern New England would pay about $30 million for the shares.

Southern New England also said its board also approved the transaction, under which each Woodbury common stock would be exchanged for an amount of Southern New England common stock with a market value of $43 at the time of closing.
